name: Canonical Company Search
description:
Canonical is a company data API and remote MCP server built for the long tail — the companies others miss. 
Describe what you want in plain English (or pass structured filters) and it retrieves from a curated corpus of millions, verifying each candidate against products/services, target customer, and business model with an LLM evaluator. 
You get a precise, domain-keyed shortlist: signal, not a noisy page of links.

Two workflows, one graph. 
Discovery: search for companies matching an ICP, or pull look-alikes from a seed domain. 
Enrichment: resolve a free-text company name to a canonical domain, then retrieve the full company record — funding (round series from pre-seed through growth, amount raised, post-money valuation, investors, last-raise date), founding year, employee count, HQ city/state/country, founder and executive slates with role, LinkedIn, and prior-employer tags like FAANG or unicorn, plus corporate-family links (parents, ultimate parent, subsidiaries, joint ventures). Founder and leadership coverage is a curated subset, not the whole corpus.

Built for agents: everything is keyed by domain, so an agent runs the whole loop without holding state — look up a name, drill into the profile, hop to a related company, or fan out to look-alikes.

Free tier to start with, no credit card required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Canonical Company Search to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Canonical Company Search to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://trycanonical.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Canonical Company Search MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canonical Company Search provides these MCP tools: find_similar_companies, get_account_status, get_company_details, lookup_companies, and search_companies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Canonical Company Search?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Canonical Company Search in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Canonical Company Search MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Canonical Company Search requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Canonical Company Search is developed by Canonical. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
